---
title: Export formats
description: Export generated wallet sets to .env, JSON, CSV, Hardhat config, and Foundry config — each with seed phrases, addresses, and chain-specific secrets.
---

Export quality is the main differentiator. Every format includes the seed phrase, public address, and chain-specific secret, plus a development-only header. All serialization happens in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

## .env

Ready-to-paste variables, with RPC placeholders for each network.

```bash
# Generated by walletgenerator.dev
# Development/test wallets only. Do not use for production funds.

NETWORK_MODE=testnet

WALLET_1_SEED_PHRASE="word1 word2 ... word12"

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY_1=0x...
EVM_ADDRESS_1=0x...

SOLANA_SECRET_KEY_BASE58_1=...
SOLANA_SECRET_KEY_ARRAY_1=[...]
SOLANA_ADDRESS_1=...

STELLAR_SECRET_KEY_1=S...
STELLAR_PUBLIC_KEY_1=G...

XRP_SEED_1=sEd...
XRP_ADDRESS_1=r...

BITCOIN_WIF_1=...
BITCOIN_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX_1=...
BITCOIN_ADDRESS_1=tb1q...
```

A network-configuration block with RPC placeholders is appended for the chains you selected (Sepolia and other EVM testnets, Solana RPC, Stellar Horizon, XRPL WebSocket, Bitcoin network/address type).

## JSON

Structured wallet sets for scripts and fixtures.

```json
{
  "generatedBy": "walletgenerator.dev",
  "networkMode": "testnet",
  "warning": "Development/test wallets only. Do not use for production funds.",
  "wallets": [
    {
      "index": 1,
      "seedPhrase": "word1 word2 ... word12",
      "evm": { "address": "0x...", "privateKey": "0x...", "compatibleChains": ["ethereum", "..."] },
      "solana": { "address": "...", "secretKeyBase58": "...", "secretKeyArray": [] },
      "stellar": { "publicKey": "G...", "secretKey": "S..." },
      "xrp": { "address": "r...", "seed": "sEd...", "privateKey": "..." },
      "bitcoin": { "network": "testnet", "addressType": "p2wpkh", "address": "tb1q...", "wif": "..." }
    }
  ]
}
```

## CSV

One row per wallet set — ideal for spreadsheets and bulk imports.

```text
index,network_mode,seed_phrase,evm_address,evm_private_key,solana_address,solana_secret_key_base58,stellar_public_key,stellar_secret_key,xrp_address,xrp_seed,xrp_private_key,bitcoin_address,bitcoin_wif,bitcoin_private_key_hex
```

## Hardhat

A `hardhat.config.ts` with EVM private keys wired into the in-process `hardhat` network and common testnets. Full walkthrough: [Hardhat accounts](/guides/hardhat/).

## Foundry

`PRIVATE_KEY_*` environment variables plus a `foundry.toml` `rpc_endpoints` snippet. Full walkthrough: [Foundry wallets](/guides/foundry/).

## Attribution

Exports include a small comment header:

```text
Generated by walletgenerator.dev
Development/test wallets only.
```

This is a plain comment — there are no tracking links and nothing that compromises privacy.
